direct_decode_restart.observed: With shadows at 2 Mbit/s the direct decoder failed with 'Decoding error.' and stayed off until the session ended. It did not fail in the runs without shadows, or in 31 minutes on PVE.
direct_decode_restart.change: A decode error now restarts the decoder at the next key frame; the browser path shows the stream meanwhile. Unsupported streams, and a fourth error within 60 s, still end the path.
direct_decode_restart.verified: Unit tests with a fake decoder, then live: restart-t2, 3 rounds on the VM with shadows, 6 decode errors in about 20 minutes, direct decode returned each time and no session-long failure. restart-t1 had no error.
direct_decode_restart.cause_not_established: Whether the error follows pictures dropped ahead of the decoder has not been shown.
direct_decode_restart.before: Without the change the first error ended direct decode for the session (soak213-vm3, shon-t1, shon-t2).
